title: 第1961章 云汐第1960章 微风引澜
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
入目的是一顶淡紫色的纱帐，轻薄如烟，在微风中轻轻飘动，阳光从竹窗的缝隙中洒入，
空气中一丝若有若无的幽香，像是什么花的味道，又像是某种女子身上的体香。
江尘眨了眨眼，试图让自己清醒一些，
全身依旧疼痛，但并没有他想象中那么剧烈。
他能感觉到体内两股磅礴的药力在缓缓流转，一股是他熟悉的圣品丹药，另一股则是一种陌生的药力，
品阶之高，完全不下于界主赐下的圣药。
两股药力交织在一起，效果成倍的增加，原本断裂的经脉，竟已经修复了大半，
他很清楚自己受的伤有多重...经脉断裂七成，血脉近乎枯竭，五脏六腑都有不同程度的损伤，那种伤势换做寻常修士，十条命都不够死。
可现在，他不但活了下来，伤势还在以一种惊人的速度恢复。
是谁救了他？
江尘缓缓转过头，想要打量四周。
然后，他愣住了。
床前灵气浮动，一道修长纤细的身影逐渐从朦胧中显现出来，
江尘的呼吸，在看清那张面容的瞬间，停顿了一瞬。
那是一个女子。
她身着素裙，玉骨天生，容颜几近完美，挑不出一点瑕疵，体态纤柔修长，
更重要的是她身上那种气质...温柔清心，不染纤尘，让人望之便生出一种自惭形秽之感，仿佛多看一眼都是对她的亵渎。
江尘怔怔地看着她，艰难道：
“你…你是谁？难道是天界的仙女？”
这话说得有些傻，却是他此刻最真实的感受，

他见过无数美人，见过那样南宫婉儿的妖娆尤物，见过凤昔儿那样的倾城之姿，林曦月、苏玄璃，秦紫烟，更都是人间绝色，
可眼前的这个女子，给他的感觉完全不同，她身上有一种从未见过的气质，仿佛她本就不属于这个纷扰的尘世，只是一时谪落人间。
虞紫鸢嫣然一笑，如同春水融冰，让整个房间都明亮了几分，
“叫我云汐即可。”
“云汐...”
江尘喃喃重复了一遍这个名字，只觉得这名字与她的人一般清雅出尘，相得益彰，他挣扎着想要坐起身来，却发现全身酸软无力，连这个简单的动作都做不到。
“是你救了我？”
虞紫鸢点了点头，在床边的绣墩上坐下，那双清眸中带着一丝关切，却又不让人觉得过分亲近，分寸把握得恰到好处。
“公子受伤，从虚空中落下，恰巧落在云汐的飞阁之上，当时公子浑身是血，气息奄奄，我便擅作主张将公子带了进来，还望公子莫怪。”
江尘怔了怔，随即心中涌起一股复杂，
他在太玄天的这段时间，已经领教够了世间的冷漠，金瑶公主屠杀一城的外来者，连眼皮都不眨一下。
媚仙菲为了屠圣一剑，眼睁睁看着荆苍云陨落，也不肯出手相救，那些大族天骄，更是一个都高高在上，视人命如草芥。
反倒是这个与自己素不相识的女子，不仅救下了自己，还拿出了这种品阶的圣药。
他的声音郑重：
“多谢...仙子。”
他挣扎着想要起身行礼，却因为牵动了伤势，一阵剧痛袭来，让他闷哼一声，再度跌回榻上。
content_en:
What you see is a lavender gauze tent, as thin as smoke, gently fluttering in the breeze, and the sun shines in through the gaps in the bamboo window.
There is a faint fragrance in the air, like the smell of some flowers, or like the body fragrance of some kind of woman.
Jiang Chen blinked and tried to wake himself up.
There was still pain all over his body, but it wasn't as severe as he imagined.
He could feel two powerful medicinal powers flowing slowly in his body. One was the holy elixir he was familiar with, and the other was an unfamiliar medicinal power.
The level is as high as the holy medicine given by the Realm Lord.
The two medicinal powers are intertwined, and the effect is doubled. Most of the originally broken meridians have been repaired.
He knew very well how serious his injuries were... 70% of his meridians were broken, his blood was almost exhausted, and his internal organs were damaged to varying degrees. For an ordinary monk, ten lives would not be enough to kill an ordinary monk.
But now, not only has he survived, his injuries are still recovering at an alarming speed.
Who saved him?
Jiang Chen slowly turned his head and wanted to look around.
Then, he froze.
The spiritual energy floated in front of the bed, and a slender figure gradually emerged from the haze.
Jiang Chen's breathing paused for a moment when he saw that face clearly.
That's a woman.
She is wearing a plain skirt, has natural jade bones, her face is almost perfect, no flaws can be found, and her figure is slender and slender.
What's more important is her temperament...gentle and pure, untainted by fine dust, which makes people feel ashamed when they look at her, as if even looking at her is a blasphemy.
Jiang Chen looked at her blankly and said with difficulty:
"You...who are you? Are you a fairy from heaven?"
This was a bit silly to say, but it was his truest feeling at the moment.
He has seen countless beauties, such as Nangong Wan'er's enchanting beauty, Feng Xi'er's stunning appearance, Lin Xiyue, Su Xuanli, and Qin Ziyan, all of whom are stunning in the world.
But the woman in front of him gave him a completely different feeling. She had a temperament that he had never seen before, as if she did not belong to this troubled world and was just temporarily banished to the world.
Yu Ziyuan smiled brightly, like spring water melting ice, making the whole room a little brighter.
"Just call me Yun tide."
"Yun tide..."
Jiang Chen murmured and repeated the name, feeling that the name complemented her elegance and elegance. He struggled to sit up, but found that his whole body was so weak that he could not even do this simple movement.
"Did you save me?"
Yu Ziyuan nodded and sat down on the embroidered pillar beside the bed. There was a trace of concern in her clear eyes, but she did not make people feel too close, and she had just the right amount of sense.
"The young master was injured and fell from the sky. He happened to land on Yun tide's flying pavilion. At that time, the young master was covered in blood and his breath was dying. I took the initiative and brought the young master in. I hope you don't blame him."
Jiang Chen was stunned for a moment, and then a complex feeling surged in his heart.
During his time in Taixuantian, he had experienced enough indifference in the world. Princess Jin Yao slaughtered outsiders in a city without even batting an eyelid.
Mei Xianfei watched Jing Cangyun fall for the sake of slaughtering the saint with her sword, but refused to save her. Those prodigies from the rich families were all aloof and regarded human life as nothing.
On the contrary, this woman, whom he had never met before, not only saved him, but also took out a holy medicine of this level.
His voice was solemn:
"Thank you...Fairy."
He struggled to get up and salute, but due to the injury, a sharp pain hit him, making him groan and fall back on the couch again.
